case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel's location next to the sanctuary/Basilica, attentive and friendly staff, clean, spacious rooms and comfortable beds, with some noting helpful gestures (kettle, offered dinner soup). Several reviews also mentioned breakfast shortcomings—limited choices, no vegetables or needing improvement and an early end time—and one guest noted morning light coming through the shades.
